answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 8137 Country: India Title: Is contraceptive pills/Condom/Tablets like Mala-D are permissible in Islam to control birth temporarly? Question: Is contraceptive pills/Condom/Tablets like Mala-D are permissible in Islam to control birth temporarly? Answer ID: 8137 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1050/1050=M/1429) On the basis of valid reasons, it is allowable to use temporary contraceptives (pills or condoms), otherwise it is makrooh (undesirable). You must have written what is the problem with you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
